acceptance_test: Re-run the SAME 40 frozen probes. MUST: reason-present avoid-defect stays ~100%. TARGET: reason-absent affirmative-clear drops, mass shifts into 'question'. GUARDRAIL: reason-absent 'flag' does not balloon toward baseline 16/20.
